# huiying Filter

> Qinghe County Huiying Automotive Parts Co., Ltd. — a professional manufacturer of automotive and industrial filters (air, cabin, oil, fuel filters and wipers, plus brake pads, spark plugs and rubber hoses), integrating R&D, production and sales. Brand lineage since 1996; legal entity incorporated 2017. This file lists the main pages of the site for LLM consumption.

## Site structure

- [Home](https://carfilterspro.com/): Company overview, product categories, sourcing highlights and latest news.
- [Products](https://carfilterspro.com/products/): All filter product categories.
- [Air Filter](https://carfilterspro.com/products/air-filter/): Engine air filters that remove dust and suspended particles from intake air before it reaches the combustion chamber, reducing cylinder, piston and piston-ring wear.
- [Cabin Filter](https://carfilterspro.com/products/cabin-filter/): Cabin air filters that capture dust, pollen and particulate from outside air before it enters the passenger cabin.
- [Oil Filter](https://carfilterspro.com/products/oil-filter/): Engine oil filters that remove contaminants and carbon sludge from circulating engine oil, protecting lubrication components and extending oil life.
- [Fuel Filter](https://carfilterspro.com/products/fuel-filter/): Fuel filters that remove iron oxide, dust and other impurities from fuel to prevent fuel-system blockage and reduce mechanical wear.
- [Wiper](https://carfilterspro.com/products/wiper/): Wiper blades and related wiper products for clear visibility.
- [Brake Pads](https://carfilterspro.com/products/brake-pads/): Ceramic and semi-metallic brake pads for passenger cars, matched by OE number.
- [Spark Plugs](https://carfilterspro.com/products/spark-plugs/): Ignition spark plugs for gasoline engines, matched by OE and engine application.
- [Rubber Hoses](https://carfilterspro.com/products/rubber-hoses/): EPDM, NBR and silicone hoses for cooling, fuel and air-transfer circuits, custom and OE-matched.
